title: Shared Serverless is in Beta
body: You can now use Shared Serverless to share serverless compute and a `pyproject.toml`-managed environment across notebooks and files in a Git folder. See [Use Shared Serverless for Git folders and bundles](/aws/en/compute/serverless/notebooks/shared-serverless).
